scoring.touch: sum over holdings of (holding_weight_percent × link_strength). Holding weight = holding dollar value / portfolio total × 100. Link strength from group_strengths by the holding's sector. Cash strength is always 0.
scoring.uncertainty: 4 × p × (1 − p), where p is the leading option figure as a fraction 0–1. Equals 1.0 at 50% and near 0 when one option is near 100%.
scoring.attention: touch × uncertainty, plus touch × 0.5 when a meaningful move is present under Product task 7 (5 points or more versus about 24 hours earlier, lasting at least one hour). Cap at touch.
scoring.update_rule: Scores update only when Polymarket percentages move. Not from news. Whether or not the event happens, the score follows the figure.
scoring.one_event_rule: Related options in one event count as one event, not several.

insight_lines.if_happens: If it happens (Guess): This could touch about {touch_rounded}% of your portfolio, mostly {top_holdings}; {extra}.
insight_lines.if_not: If it does not happen (Guess): The other result would be the surprise against today's leading figure, and could touch the same {touch_rounded}%.
